Work in progress page on documenting NixOS compatibility with the device with additional useful informations

## Status

The device boots NixOS, but sometimes freezes and the WiFi doesn't work

## Known issues

### Booting

The device is capable of running a 64-bit operating system, but it's bootloader can only be 32-bit...
